How to import data

We are checking for
Effect of the pathogen on celery (both varieties each) and then pairwise test to prove that they have similar susceptibility
effect of the pathogen on parsley (both varieties each)

1. First Shapiro Wilk to check residuals
2. t-test to compare celery varieties susceptibility 
3. ANOVA for parsley-italien, parsley-curly, & both celery varieties (i.e. if celery similar susceptibility) one anova for each 

Test to see if residuals are distributed normally
```{r}

names(F1)
celery <- F1 |> dplyr::filter(Plant == "Celery", height_final > 0)
# keeps only surviving plants

m <- aov(Total_weight ~ Variety * Treatment + Block, data = celery) # not good

shapiro.test(residuals(m))
# differences within a group are distributed normal (high p-value)

plot(m, 2)
```
